explanation: Only active at D1, when a reward shows up right after one or more unrewarded trials, and more so later in the episode (about trial 50 and later): about 10 after two or more misses in a row, about 1-5 after a single miss, then about 2-4 at the next D1 if the reward repeats and 0 after that. It is 0 at every GO and D2 step, at every D1 after an unrewarded trial, during long streaks of rewards, and at almost every step before trial 40.
